title: Serialize Person
description: Create a Persona class that implements Serializable, save it to a file and retrieve it.
hints: Persona must implement the Serializable interface
Use ObjectOutputStream to write the object
Use ObjectInputStream to read the object
solutionExplanation: Persona implements Serializable, which allows saving its state to a file. ObjectOutputStream writes the object and ObjectInputStream reads and rebuilds it.

title: Serialize a list
description: Serialize an ArrayList of Producto objects, save it and retrieve it.
solutionExplanation: ArrayList implements Serializable. When serializing the whole list, all Producto objects inside it are also serialized as long as they implement Serializable.
expectedOutput:
List serialized with 3 products
Laptop: $1200.0
Mouse: $25.0
Teclado: $50.0

title: Partial serialization
description: Create a class with a transient field that is not serialized, demonstrating partial serialization.
hints: Add the keyword 'transient' before the type of the password field
When deserializing, password will have the value null
Show the account before and after to compare
solutionExplanation: The keyword 'transient' indicates that the password field must not be serialized. When deserializing, its value will be null, protecting sensitive information.
expectedOutput:
=== Before serializing ===
Holder: Juan
Balance: 5000.0
Password: SECRET123

=== After deserializing ===
Holder: Juan
Balance: 5000.0
Password: null
